strategy.text: Keep every existing transaction constructor and add a funding and evaluation layer beside it, used only by the public lifecycle path. The flowchart shows live parameters flowing into the funding layer and then into the three runners.

what-the-diff-actually-built.text: One new library module owns path selection, fee reserve, minimum change, deposits, budget verification, filtered funding, the aggregate limit check, and evaluate-and-rebalance. The node setup gains a planned-funding entry with no fixed floor. The three runners call the layer only on the public path.

verification-as-shipped.text: Docs checks green, 109 passing cage tests, the lifecycle attach check green, read-only preprod allowance plans, and no submitted public transaction. The retroactive audit killed a mutant on the reserved-input row.

file-fence-files-the-merge-touched.text: Three new files and seven edited offchain files. No Lean, validator, workflow, or check-setting edits.

slice.text: One slice: public lifecycle funding and evaluation, shipped as two fix commits.
